description: Create a Discord bot schedule, recurring (`cron`) or one-time (`runOnceAt`); set exactly one of them. Bot owner only. action: restart, start, stop, command (needs `command`, sent to the bot console), backup (needs ZapX Pass Pro). Five-field cron evaluated in `timezone` (IANA, default UTC), at most every 5 minutes, max 20 schedules per bot. `runOnceAt` = local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone`, in the future and at most one year ahead: the schedule runs exactly once and switches itself off. Write both as the customer's local wall-clock time and set `timezone` to their zone, never convert to UTC yourself. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

command.description: Bot console command, required for action=command.

cron.description: Recurring schedule: five-field cron in local time of `timezone`, e.g. "0 4 * * *" = daily 04:00. At most every 5 minutes. Leave out for a one-time schedule (`runOnceAt`).

runOnceAt.description: One-time schedule: local date and time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone` (e.g. "2026-11-20T03:00"), in the future and at most one year ahead. Runs exactly once, then switches itself off (isActive=false). Use it for "once tomorrow at 3am", never a cron with a fixed day and month.

serviceId.description: ID of the Discord bot: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_discord_bots (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron / runOnceAt is evaluated in, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Default UTC.

name: create_discord_bot_schedule
title: Create Discord Bot Schedule
